name: mesa
description: Mesa's Vulkan drivers the client runs on, from the djohansson/mesa fork: KosmicKrisp, a driver over Metal, which the fork adds ray queries to (VK_KHR_acceleration_structure, VK_KHR_ray_query); and lavapipe, a driver on the cpu (llvmpipe), for headless runs without a gpu (CI).

kosmickrisp.description: KosmicKrisp, a Vulkan driver over Metal, whose OpenCL kernels mesa_clc compiles at build time with LLVM's clang

lavapipe.description: lavapipe, a Vulkan driver on the cpu over llvmpipe, which compiles shaders with LLVM at run time (linked statically)
